every stitch has a past life

Established 2026 in the Illawarra, on the floor of my sharehouse.

Every towel is thrifted, washed, and made into a colourful garment — or, if they're white or another undesirable colour, I hand-dye them. The SquigoLi logo is hand-painted onto each branded garment, and seams are double-stitched to avoid bulk and increase longevity.

what we make

Handmade from thrifted towels. Every piece is one of a kind.

Shirts

Oversized fit — either cropped or full himbo length. Each one hand-painted with the SquigoLi logo and double-stitched for longevity.

available now

Shorts

Medium length to prevent riding up, with internal pockets. Double-stitched seams for a clean finish that lasts.

available now

Custom

Bring your own special towel, or request a custom colourway. Get in touch and we'll make something unique.

ask us

good for the ocean. great to wear.

I believe in slow fashion — making unique garments that will last the test of time. I make the clothes I want to wear. Every piece starts as a discarded towel, thrifted and given a second life. If the colour doesn't work, I hand-dye it until it does.
